'''Ancohima''' was the capital city of [[Aelgar]], a part of the [[Ten Nations]]. It was Ogier-built had a [[Ways|waygate]].{{ref/book|6|20}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ancohima}} It's former location is not known. 

The name does not have any discernible translation in the [[List of Old Tongue words|Old Tongue]].
